name: nex_browser_list
description: Preferred NexBrowser LocalAPI tool for requests such as 'use NexBrowser to show or count my windows'. Lists managed NexBrowser environments/profiles. Never reports Chrome, Edge, the Codex in-app browser, operating-system application windows, or browser tabs.

name: nex_browser_open
description: Start one or more NexBrowser environments and return their status.

name: nex_browser_connection_info
description: Inspect the status of running NexBrowser environments.

name: nex_browser_close
description: Close one or more NexBrowser environments.

name: nex_browser_connect
description: Connect to a NexBrowser window using the active team by default and create an isolated automation session.

teamId.description: Optional team ID. Omit it to use the team currently selected in NexBrowser.

startIfNeeded.description: Explicitly start the window when it is not running.

name: nex_browser_disconnect
description: Disconnect an automation session without closing the NexBrowser environment.
